data.title: 在原七海 · 雨夜的留言
data.description: 外面的雨还没停，七海在纸条上写好第二天的安排，顺手加了一句“别忘了带伞”。她把纸条放在你常坐的位置，等你回来一起喝茶。
data.action: placing a handwritten note beside a teacup
data.promptProse: Inside a quiet home at night, Nanami carefully places a handwritten note beside a steaming porcelain teacup on the wooden dining table. Rain streaks the windowpane in the background, diffusing the soft, warm glow of the table lamp, creating a cozy and intimate atmosphere.
data.animaCaption: The note waits beside the cup for her partner.
